newsitem.title: USA: Vermont Yankee sees nuke at full power Mon night.
newsitem.headline: Vermont Yankee sees nuke at full power Mon night.

text.p: Vermont Yankee Nuclear Power Corp's 510 megawatt Vermont Yankee plant will likely return to full power Monday night after restarting from a fuel outage, a company spokesman said Monday.
"It looks like we will hit 100 percent overnight," said spokesman Rob Williams.
The Vernon, Vt. plant was producing at about 65 percent of capacity Monday morning and boosting power after synchronizing to the electricity grid on Saturday, Williams said.
The plant was shut August 23 for refueling and maintenance.

Vermont Yankee is owned by a consortium of New England utilities including Central Vermont Public Service Co, New England Electric System, Green Mountain Power, Northeast Utilities and Central Maine Power Co.
